fields.title: Lateral heat flow and structural temperature projection
fields.finding: The face/core solve omits lateral heat flow and keeps only temperature harmonics 2–6 for bending. Pole and mean-projection errors are corrected, but a physical truncation bound is absent.
fields.needed: Resolve lateral conduction, seams and required spatial/temporal load spectrum; validate structural response to the resulting field.
